scope: Links executed effect assertions, independently of serialized-field retention. This is not a per-field completeness pass. Unlisted executable families and additional input domains remain pending.

families.scope: Actual shipped WASM dynamic-value/package execution; no GDScript/C# compatibility claim.

checks: isolated actual WASM: reflection and Fn/curry/call intrinsics
isolated actual WASM: string, map, array and iterator packages
isolated actual WASM: blob and JSON standard packages

families.scope: Original and structurally emitted scripts produce the asserted observable WASM results.

checks: arrays, maps and compound writes: independent structural emission preserves WASM observable result
captured closure: independent structural emission preserves WASM observable result

families.scope: Actual slot mutations, serialized graph restoration and VM execution. Browser wiring geometry remains separate.

checks: Function parameter reordering changes execution order while retaining stable slot and pin IDs
Array slot reorder/removal changes values and removes only the removed pin connections
Block statement order and removal change the executed sequence; serialization preserves undo snapshots

families.scope: Production resolver and runtime with real WASM, graph compiler and AssetDatabase; unrelated subsystem fixtures remain explicit.

checks: production text runtime resolves and executes project helper
production visual runtime uses identical module resolution and VM behavior without changing debug state
failed override preserves the prior stored playable source

families.scope: Actual inherited variant resolution merges parent and child token values; invalid selection preserves stored source.

checks: Inherited active variants survive save/reload and unresolved selections cannot mutate saved source

families.scope: Actual instantiated entity components/metadata/position and event reference. This is not complete event-dispatch or inheritance coverage.

checks: Actual blueprint instantiation applies required components, tags, groups, position and event binding

families.scope: Native body, primary collider and connection updates after creation.

checks: Every scalar body/material/primary collider ABI binding accepts edits after body creation with the same native handle
Joint and rope property edits reach retained connection records without stale rope data overwriting joint limits

families.scope: Live facade queries, tile collision identity and filters.

checks: Live transform, layer, sensor and enabled edits reach existing native handles without invalidation
Real TileMap collision bodies return their scene owner and support exclusions

families.scope: Path algorithms, live authored cache invalidation and agent stopping.

checks: Every grid algorithm routes around real obstacles; polygon visibility uses the same geometry
Agent radius, authored radius, transforms, masks and disabled regions invalidate cached paths
Finished and unreachable navigation agents stop the actual simulation velocity

families.scope: Blackboard, task revision/lifetime and perception.

checks: AI blackboard writes persist across ticks and authored revision/retirement resets Wait and overrides
Perception uses world units, parent rotation, tags, deterministic distance ties and bounded results

families.scope: Live scene leases, persistence and transition placement.

checks: Reactive scene hosts preserve shared leases, persistent descendants and lifetime generations across unload/reload
Scene transition aligns new entities with shifted persistent objects and preserves origin-relative connections

families.scope: Top-down controller only; other gameplay component semantics require their own cases.

checks: Top-down component input accelerates once per fixed tick, stops after release and respects collisions

families.scope: Pose sampling, interpolation, root motion and controller transitions.

checks: Direct clip seek evaluates actual numeric pose without crossed callbacks
Step keys switch at interior boundaries and Auto tangents use adjacent slopes
Explicit root-motion extraction covers multiple and reverse loops without absolute teleport
Looping animator reaches its exit-time-one transition

families.scope: Rig constraints, retargeting and skin deformation.

checks: Rotation limits remain authoritative after inverse kinematics
Retargeting an unchanged rest pose preserves the target rest transform
Rig skin deformation preserves mirrored bind geometry and follows translated root pose

families.scope: Crossed callback ordering, nested sampling and traversal.

checks: Timeline emits every crossed occurrence over multiple loops
Timeline samples assigned animation asset with local offset and rate
Reverse timeline dispatch order follows traversal and explicit seek dispatches nothing

families.scope: Actual UI-triggered timeline action behavior.

checks: Explicit play evaluates initial subtitle, pause freezes real timeline, and play resumes
Skip and resume reconstruct real captions and marker time

families.scope: Executed audio runtime with instrumented media elements; physical sound/device acceptance is not implied.

checks: Regular source and polyphonic clocks follow scaled transport, manual pause, seek and trim end
Solo nested bus keeps its ancestors audible and unrelated sibling silent
Bus automation holds its end unless an explicit loop duration is set

families.scope: Resolved UI layout geometry; separate browser tests inspect actual editor panels.

checks: Partial stretch anchors independently resolve both axes and inset offsets
Fixed pixels, responsive scale, breakpoints and safe area use the same geometry
Wrapped Flow uses authored widths, line breaks and spacing deterministically

families.scope: Game UI activation, slider callbacks and native text ownership.

checks: Checkbox requires pointer release inside; cancellation and outside release remain inert
Slider pointer and keyboard emit changed-value callbacks once and clamp repeat input
Keyboard text focus creates native-input ownership and commits values atomically

families.scope: Theme inheritance and resolved localized text.

checks: Child theme omission preserves parent tokens, variables and every state
Multi-hop locale fallback and Canvas locale override resolve actual text and direction

families.scope: Authored replication policy, ownership and live RPC contract binding.

checks: Incoming snapshots obey the authored property allowlist
Explicit live owner edits reach ownership while unrelated property edits preserve transfers
RPC contracts added during a live session reach gameplay listeners

families.scope: Actual pixel assertions on the recorded browser/software graphics context; no native pixel equivalence or universal FPS claim.

checks: actual GLSL material changes pixels and invalid shader uses visible base fallback
actual particle simulation produces matching visible pixels in both renderer backends
normal-map lighting follows sprite flips and local rotation
